description: Synthetic: Codex's `codex login --device-auth` screen, a sign-in link, a one-time code, and a last line 'Enter code ABCD-12345'. That line is typed in the browser, not into the pane, so there is no question; the user finishes the sign-in there, so the pane waits on the user, as a shell's browser login does (sample 82). The link and code stay as links/copyables.
